title: Dorsey and the National Baptist Convention; why he never promoted himself
summary: Asked about his piano and organ style, the companion says Dorsey never promoted himself and helped others gain fame. Dorsey describes coming with the National Baptist Convention and preparing musicians for weeks beforehand.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: So your original piano style and organ style would have been learned from your mother, you think?

Well now you didn't come here while you were in gospel this is... No, I'm not in gospel. No, no, you didn't know while he was in gospel. He didn't know. He traveled with the convention now. Convention? Well, you're probably one of the things that we need to make note here, and the reason that he has not gained the fame as he should have had, I mean, you know, all of the accolades, is because he has never been one to promote himself. You see, he never promoted himself. He always helped others, and it was those others who gained the fame. So now he has a promoter, okay, and he deserves to be promoted.

Well I came here with the National Baptist Convention, that's one of the biggest organizations in the country. Come here with him, played for him. Remember that? Remember that? He helped him to bring the musicians out, I mean, teach the musicians. And we'd start on that, and of course it didn't be very much for us. We'd start on that three or four weeks before convention time. Getting these folk together, they couldn't all come to the same place, but they're scattered all over the country. You'd go to here, to this one tonight, go to somebody the next night, or somebody out of town the next night, and then when you get them all in, when you got down to the big meetings, you had them all put them together. They'd do stuff that's all. It's just that easy, if you knew how to do it.
